Based on the bounded workspace snapshot, the project is a Go-based local coding agent located at `/Users/united_pooh/PyProjects/go-code`. The primary entry point is `cmd/agent/main.go`. The architecture is organized into several internal packages: `internal/loop` (instruction management, prompt building, runner), `internal/message` (message types), `internal/model` (client, config, streaming, Anthropic integration), `internal/session` (JSONL store for session persistence), `internal/settings`, `internal/pipeline` (review artifacts), `internal/streamma` (runtime, broker, planning, evidence, parser, topology, event logging), and `internal/subagent` (subagent management). There are also top-level pipeline workspace artifacts (`.pipeline-workspace/`) including architecture, design, spec, validation, review history, and execution reports, suggesting an automated pipeline process exists. Test files are present for most packages (`*_test.go`). The `.codegraph` directory indicates some code graph analysis tooling, and `.codewhale/instructions.md` suggests an additional code review/analysis component. Coverage gaps are limited by the snapshot: source files for `internal/tool` are not listed, and no actual `.go` file content beyond `go.mod` and `README` is provided, so runtime behavior, specific data structures, and function signatures cannot be verified from this evidence alone.
END_STEP
